description: Structured registry of KNOWN, ACCEPTED errors in blessed seasons. The official record (2024 reference DB, 2025 golden baseline) deliberately keeps these rows as they were scored; the logic that caused them is fixed from the season in `fixedFrom` via server/config/scoringRulesets.js. The Double Check downgrades any finding that matches an entry to INFO ('KNOWN'), so audits of old seasons read clean while the error stays documented. tests/integration/doublecheckRubricAgreement.test.js asserts each entry's `stored` value is still what the database holds — if someone recalculates and silently 'fixes' one, that test fails and this file must be updated on purpose. Never edit the database to make an entry go away; a commissioner ruling to apply one retroactively means: lower the rule's season, recalc, re-bless, delete the entry.
